rationale: The reviewer found that SelectKBest runs on all 60 samples before CV. They measured a nested-CV AUROC of 0.51, which roughly matches the key's ~0.58 near-chance drop, and a permutation null of 0.987 confirms the leak. They proposed in-fold selection plus an independent cohort. Their other points (baselines, possible batch effects) are generic caveats rather than distinct substantive issues.
